package scenarionet

import (
	"context"

	syncsender "GENRE_MODULE/game/handler/syncsender"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/msgid"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/pb"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/client/wire"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/gateway"
)

// CoopDispatch 增加有权限检查的权威视图查询，供进入房间、重连与客户端验收使用。
func CoopDispatch(engine *nest.NestMgr) gateway.TCPDispatch {
	commands := Dispatch(engine)
	views := syncsender.NewCoopViewHandlersSender(engine)
	return func(ctx context.Context, session gateway.Session, id, seq uint32, kind wire.PayloadKind, data []byte) (any, error) {
		if id != msgid.MsgCoopView {
			return commands(ctx, session, id, seq, kind, data)
		}
		if kind != wire.PayloadProtobuf {
			return nil, gateway.ErrInvalidRequest
		}
		request, err := pb.UnmarshalCoopViewRequest(data)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		view, err := views.MultiSync_CoopView(ctx, request.RoomID, session.Principal().PlayerID)
		response := &pb.CoopViewResponse{Revision: view.Revision, NextSeq: view.NextSeq, Stage: int32(view.Stage), Cleared: view.Cleared, Claimed: view.Claimed, Coins: view.Coins}
		if err != nil {
			response.Code = 1
		}
		payload, err := pb.MarshalCoopViewResponse(response)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return &gateway.TCPResponse{MessageID: id, Sequence: seq, Payload: payload}, nil
	}
}
